verdict.rationale: Cursor ships an official CLI documented at cursor.com/cli with install script, headless/print mode for scripts and CI, structured JSON/stream-json output, ACP support, permission tokens, GitHub Actions integration, and service-account auth for non-interactive use — directly matching the ai-native agentic CLI story. missing for 10: independent/community hands-on validation of the CLI itself (only vendor docs and probes cited).
